Consistent with Alo’s “Together We Win” principle, the Senior Analyst works collaboratively across functions, shares insights, builds alignment, and helps stakeholders turn data into meaningful action. jobs.title: Senior Employment Counsel
jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW ALO is seeking a mid-to-senior employment attorney to manage employment counseling, contract, and policy needs as we expand in North America. This position is a great opportunity for an experienced attorney looking to take ownership of a broad array of employment issues in a fast-paced, growing company. As Senior Employment Counsel, you will serve as a key legal advisor on all aspects of employment law, policy, immigration and compliance across our U.S. and Canada operations. You will work closely with ALO’s Director of Employment, HR, Retail, and Payroll teams to ensure that our company remains compliant with local, state, federal, and international labor laws, while also addressing a wide range of legal matters related to our workforce. You will also mentor and support other members of the legal team on employment matters. The ideal candidate has six to ten years of experience with employment advice and counseling at a top employment law firm and in-house. The position is an in-office role based in Beverly Hills, CA. RESPONSIBILITIES Provide day-to-day legal advice on employment law matters, including accommodations, classification, compensation, discipline, hiring, immigration/right-to-work, leaves of absence, separations and workplace investigations. jobs.description_text: About the Role Are you a Nurse Practitioner who thrives on connecting with patients and making a real difference in their health outcomes? Do you want to leave behind rigid, cookie-cutter systems and join a dynamic, patient-centered organization that values your creativity and clinical expertise? If you're passionate about improving outcomes at scale and energized by meaningful patient engagement, we want you on our team. At Galileo, we're transforming healthcare by delivering personalized, comprehensive care to those who need it most — underserved patients and those with complex medical needs. We use technology, data, and operational rigor to drive outcomes, and we believe the clinicians doing this work are central to that mission. We're a digital-first medical group, and we're proud of the culture we've built: inclusive, collaborative, and deeply committed to health equity. Galileo is looking for a culturally-competent Nurse Practitioner to join our Population Health team. In this role, you will use phone and video-based care to provide high-quality, comprehensive follow-up care to patients who are post-hospital discharge. Here's what you'll do: Cover our care needs for our Transitions of Care program. Day to day work includes telephonic outreach (“cold calls”) and scheduled video/phone visits for patients who have recently been hospitalized and discharged. Visits focus on: Medication reconciliation, symptom screening, and ordering of any needed follow-up labs, medications

Freeform is hiring a Principal Machine Learning Researcher to lead the development of advanced learning and control problems in a production-scale, AI-native metal manufacturing system. jobs.title: Senior Manager : Tax Technology Implementations
jobs.description_text: About the Team The Tax Technology team owns the technology behind what happens on our platform. We build and run the systems that calculate indirect tax on every transaction — and we go well beyond that. We build the automations and implementations the direct tax team relies on, we support data operations across the tax function, and we develop the tooling and efficiencies that make the wider Tax Force faster. We are a global team spanning three brands: DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. That reach also makes us one of the most dependency-heavy systems in the company. More than eight separate billing domains feed into our tax services, each with its own architecture, roadmap, and engineering team — and all of them have to work. Getting this right is not optional. Tax has to be correct on every order, the first time. Getting it wrong means incorrect charges to real customers, restatement risk, and audit exposure. We are looking for someone who can hold the whole picture and make it land. About the Role The Senior Manager, Tax Technology Implementations reports to the Director of Tax Technology and owns the technical implementation plan between the various domains and our indirect tax calculation service. This position will be based on the East Coast to accommodate working in Eastern Time hours. jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer - DoorDash Air
jobs.description_text: About the Team The DoorDash Air team is bringing drone delivery to reality. Come join us to build a new class of aircrafts and deploy at scale. DoorDash Labs, established in 2018, serves as the innovation hub for DoorDash, focusing on developing automation and robotics solutions to enhance last-mile logistics. The team's mission is to create technologies that support and augment human networks, aiming to improve efficiency for Dashers, merchants, and consumers alike. We’re ruthlessly focused on business impact. We are a highly senior team composed of former pioneers from a variety of different robotics industries. As of 2025, DoorDash has completed 10B lifetime deliveries. We’re focused on how to do the next 10B even better. Joining Process Management: Oversee the installation and monitoring of structural fasteners, support the production quality audit and data collection from the production team.
